comment: Debug-mode dwarven Valkyrie steps off the stairs, reads a cursed scroll of punishment, wishes a pit under herself and a boulder that drops into it and buries the iron ball, leaving her tethered (TT_BURIEDBALL). She moves one square within the chain reach, wishes a second pit there (maketrap() leaves the tether because the ball is buried elsewhere) and a second boulder; flooreffects() drops it into the pit with her, delfloortrap() keeps the buried-ball tether, so flooreffects() resets it itself (do.c:263-264). She then walks three squares east, which only an untethered hero can do. Independent seed, date and character.
